items.title: Scientist profile
items.text:
A second-generation
scientist fighting against
world-wide diseases.
HOME Johannesburg
AGE 35

mechanics.effect: Profile sticker. Home Johannesburg, age 35. The words second-generation and world-wide are hyphenated. No personal name is printed.
Portrait sticker with no printed text. A person with long wavy brown hair in a white lab coat over a pink shirt.

items.title: Scientist
items.text:
Scientist. Once on your turn, as a free action,
destroy an Infection card in the discard pile
matching your current city.

mechanics.effect: Destroy an Infection card in the discard pile matching your current city.
restrictions: The Infection card must match your current city
The card must be in the discard pile

items.title: Create this character
items.text:
Immediately create this character using the stickers
below and add it to the pool of characters.

mechanics.effect: Immediately build this character from the profile, portrait, and Scientist sticker and add it to the character pool.

summary: Create the Scientist at once and add that character to the pool. Home Johannesburg, age 35.
